examples.chinese: 天氣太熱，我要喝飲料。
examples.pinyin: Tiānqì tài rè, wǒ yào hē yǐnliào.
examples.english: The weather is too hot, I want some beverage.

examples.chinese: 我太累了，不想去玩。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ tài lèi le, bù xiǎng qù wán.
examples.english: I am so tired! I do not want to hang out.

examples.chinese: 太好了！我最愛吃牛肉麵。他們也賣飲料嗎？
examples.pinyin: Tài hǎo le! Wǒ zuì ài chī niúròu miàn. Tāmen yě mài yǐnliào ma?
examples.english: That is awesome! Beef noodles is my favorite. Do they sell drinks as well?

examples.chinese: 這家餐廳人太多，我們去那家餐廳，好嗎？他們的牛肉麵很好吃，也很便宜。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng rén tài duō. Wǒmen qù nà jiā cāntīng, hǎo ma? Tāmen de niúròu miàn hěn hǎochī, yě hěn piányi.
examples.english: There are too many people in this restaurant. How about that restaurant? They have delicious beef noodles, and it is also cheap.

examples.chinese: 這枝筆太貴了，你買便宜的吧。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhī bǐ tài guì le, nǐ mǎi piányi de ba.
examples.english: This pen is too expensive, you had better buy a cheaper one.

examples.chinese: 這支筆太貴了，你買便宜的吧。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhī bǐ tài guì le, nǐ mǎi piányi de ba.
examples.english: This pen is too expensive; buy a cheap one (suggestion).

examples.chinese: 我的房間不太大。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de fángjiān bú tài dà.
examples.english: My room is not so big.

examples.chinese: 我的貓在房子外面曬太陽。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de māo zài fángzi wàimiàn shài tàiyáng.
examples.english: My cat is basking in the sun outside the house.

examples.chinese: 我的貓在房子外面曬太陽。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de māo zài fángzi wàimiàn shài tàiyáng.
examples.english: My cat is basking in the sun outside the house.

examples.chinese: 今天天氣不錯，我們去海邊曬太陽吧。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān tiānqì búcuò, wǒmen qù hǎibiān shài tàiyáng ba.
examples.english: The weather is nice today. Let’s go to the beach to get some sun!

examples.chinese: 我男朋友不太喜歡說話。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ nán péngyǒu bú tài xǐhuān shuōhuà.
examples.english: My boyfriend does not like to talk very much.

examples.chinese: 我不太喜歡這條裙子的顏色。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bù tài xǐhuān zhè tiáo qúnzi de yánsè.
examples.english: I don't really like the color of this skirt.

examples.chinese: 今天大家都穿很多衣服，因為天氣太冷了。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān dàjiā dōu chuān hěn duō yīfu, yīnwèi tiānqì tài lěng le.
examples.english: Today everyone is wearing a lot of clothes because the weather is too cold.

examples.chinese: 這個問題太難，我要去問老師。
examples.pinyin: Zhège wèntí tài nán, wǒ yào qù wèn lǎoshī.
examples.english: This question is too difficult; I need to go ask the teacher.

examples.chinese: 我不太會用這個牌子的電腦，你可以教我嗎？
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bù tài huì yòng zhège páizi de diànnǎo, nǐ kěyǐ jiāo wǒ ma?
examples.english: I don't really know how to use this brand of computer; can you teach me?

examples.chinese: 我最近太胖了，應該多運動，少吃一點飯。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zuìjìn tài pàng le, yīnggāi duō yùndòng, shǎo chī yīdiǎn fàn.
examples.english: I've gotten too fat recently; I should exercise more and eat a little less food.

examples.chinese: 這個孩子眼睛不太好，所以每天都戴眼鏡。
examples.pinyin: Zhège háizi yǎnjing bù tài hǎo, suǒyǐ měitiān dōu dài yǎnjìng.
examples.english: This child's eyes are not very good, so he wears glasses every day.

examples.chinese: 這張椅子不太乾淨，我要那張。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhāng yǐzi bù tài gānjìng, wǒ yào nà zhāng.
examples.english: This chair is not very clean; I want that one.

examples.chinese: 這個孩子飯吃得太少了，你有什麼好辦法？
examples.pinyin: Zhège háizi fàn chī de tài shǎo le, nǐ yǒu shénme hǎo bànfǎ?
examples.english: This child eats too little food; do you have any good method?

examples.chinese: A:你現在有空嗎？ B:我現在要跟太太出去，晚上再給你打電話。
examples.pinyin: A: Nǐ xiànzài yǒu kòng ma? B: Wǒ xiànzài yào gēn tàitai chūqù, wǎnshàng zài gěi nǐ dǎ diànhuà.
examples.english: A: Are you free now? B: I'm going out with my wife now; I'll call you again in the evening.

examples.chinese: 你這學期的成績進步了，太好了！
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zhè xuéqī de chéngjī jìnbù le, tài hǎo le!
examples.english: Your grades this semester have improved; that's great!

examples.chinese: 他今天上班遲到了，老闆不太高興。
examples.pinyin: Tā jīntiān shàngbān chídào le, lǎobǎn bú tài gāoxìng.
examples.english: He was late for work today; the boss is not too happy.

examples.chinese: 兒子跟女兒都在睡覺，你不要說得太大聲。
examples.pinyin: Érzi gēn nǚ'ér dōu zài shuìjiào, nǐ búyào shuō de tài dàshēng.
examples.english: Both my son and daughter are sleeping; don't speak too loudly.

examples.chinese: 這個孩子還太小，不能喝酒。
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge háizi hái tài xiǎo, bù néng hē jiǔ.
examples.english: This child is still too young, cannot drink alcohol.

examples.chinese: 在外國跟在自己國家的生活一定不太一樣。
examples.pinyin: Zài wàiguó gēn zài zìjǐ guójiā de shēnghuó yídìng bú tài yíyàng.
examples.english: Living in a foreign country and living in your own country are definitely not quite the same.

examples.chinese: 夏天的時候，食物不能在外面放太久。
examples.pinyin: Xiàtiān de shíhou, shíwù bù néng zài wàimiàn fàng tài jiǔ.
examples.english: In summer, food cannot be left outside for too long.

examples.chinese: 哥哥只要睡前喝太多水，就會夢到半夜起床找不到廁所，這樣的夢真可怕！
examples.pinyin: Gēge zhǐyào shuì qián hē tài duō shuǐ, jiù huì mèng dào bànyè qǐchuáng zhǎo bù dào cèsuǒ, zhèyàng de mèng zhēn kěpà!
examples.english: As long as my older brother drinks too much water before bed, he dreams of getting up in the middle of the night and not being able to find the toilet; such a dream is really scary!

examples.chinese: 今天中文口試時我太緊張了，一時不知道怎麼回答，所以成績不太好。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān Zhōngwén kǒushì shí wǒ tài jǐnzhāng le, yīshí bù zhīdào zěnme huídá, suǒyǐ chéngjī bù tài hǎo.
examples.english: During the Chinese oral exam today, I was too nervous and for a moment didn't know how to answer, so my grade wasn't very good.

examples.chinese: A:醫生說我應該多運動，少吃太鹹、太油的東西，這樣才不容易生病。 B:就是說嘛！我跟你說過好多次了，你怎麼不聽呢？
examples.pinyin: A: Yīshēng shuō wǒ yīnggāi duō yùndòng, shǎo chī tài xián, tài yóu de dōngxi, zhèyàng cái bù róngyì shēngbìng. B: Jiùshì shuō ma! Wǒ gēn nǐ shuō guò hǎo duō cì le, nǐ zěnme bù tīng ne?
examples.english: A: The doctor said I should exercise more and eat less of things that are too salty or too oily; this way it's not easy to get sick. B: Exactly! I've told you many times, why don't you listen?

examples.chinese: 李太太擔心孩子因為吃得太少，長不高，你有什麼好主意？
examples.pinyin: Lǐ tàitai dānxīn háizi yīnwèi chī de tài shǎo, zhǎng bù gāo, nǐ yǒu shénme hǎo zhǔyì?
examples.english: Mrs. Li is worried that her child won't grow tall because he eats too little. Do you have any good ideas?

examples.chinese: 因為最近太多人感冒的關係，來上課的同學變少了，我們班不過十個人，就有五個人請假 。
examples.pinyin: Yīnwèi zuìjìn tài duō rén gǎnmào de guānxi, lái shàngkè de tóngxué biàn shǎo le, wǒmen bān búguò shí ge rén, jiù yǒu wǔ ge rén qǐngjià.
examples.english: Because too many people have caught colds recently, fewer classmates are coming to class; in our class of only ten people, five have asked for leave.

examples.chinese: 剩下的飯菜加熱太多次，就沒什麼營養了，最好每餐都吃光。
examples.pinyin: Shèngxià de fàncài jiārè tài duō cì, jiù méi shénme yíngyǎng le, zuìhǎo měi cān dōu chī guāng.
examples.english: If leftover food is heated too many times, it loses its nutrition; it's best to finish it all at each meal.

examples.chinese: 小元昨天剛買了一件八千元的大衣，沒想到那家服裝店今天打三折，他太吃虧了。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎoyuán zuótiān gāng mǎi le yī jiàn bāqiān yuán de dàyī, méi xiǎngdào nà jiā fúzhuāngdiàn jīntiān dǎ sān zhé, tā tài chīkuī le.
examples.english: Xiaoyuan just bought an 8,000-yuan coat yesterday; unexpectedly, that clothing store is having a 70% off sale today—he really suffered a loss.

examples.chinese: 像踢足球那樣的運動，對年紀大的人不太合適。
examples.pinyin: Xiàng tī zúqiú nàyàng de yùndòng, duì niánjì dà de rén bù tài héshì.
examples.english: Sports like playing soccer are not very suitable for older people.

examples.chinese: 小李今天看起來比較瘦，可能是因為穿了深色衣服的關係。我妹妹剛學會游泳，就想游到水很深的地方，我覺得太危險了。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Lǐ jīntiān kàn qǐlái bǐjiào shòu, kěnéng shì yīnwèi chuān le shēnsè yīfu de guānxi. Wǒ mèimei gāng xuéhuì yóuyǒng, jiù xiǎng yóu dào shuǐ hěn shēn de dìfāng, wǒ juéde tài wēixiǎn le.
examples.english: Xiao Li looks thinner today; it might be because he wore dark-colored clothes. My younger sister just learned to swim and already wants to swim to a place where the water is very deep; I think it's too dangerous.

examples.chinese: 客人：這雙皮鞋我穿起來太緊了， 可以幫我換大一點的嗎？ 店員：沒問題，我幫你拿大一號的。
examples.pinyin: Kèrén: Zhè shuāng píxié wǒ chuān qǐlái tài jǐn le, kěyǐ bāng wǒ huàn dà yīdiǎn de ma? Diànyuán: Méi wèntí, wǒ bāng nǐ ná dà yī hào de.
examples.english: Customer: This pair of leather shoes is too tight for me; can you help me exchange them for a bigger size? Clerk: No problem, I'll get you a size larger.

examples.chinese: 最近很多人感冒了，不過不必太擔心，只要戴上口罩、別去人多的地方就行了。
examples.pinyin: Zuìjìn hěn duō rén gǎnmào le, bùguò bùbì tài dānxīn, zhǐyào dài shàng kǒuzhào, bié qù rén duō de dìfāng jiù xíng le.
examples.english: Many people have caught colds recently, but you don't need to worry too much; as long as you wear a mask and don't go to crowded places, it's all right.

examples.chinese: 買襯衫的時候得注意肩膀的大小，太大或太小都不合適。
examples.pinyin: Mǎi chènshān de shíhou děi zhùyì jiānbǎng de dàxiǎo, tài dà huò tài xiǎo dōu bù héshì.
examples.english: When buying a shirt, you need to pay attention to the size of the shoulders; too big or too small are both unsuitable.

examples.chinese: 張先生常幫太太買菜、洗衣服， 要是比太太早下班，還會把晚餐做好，真體貼。我同學很體貼父母，經常煮飯、 做家事，幫了父母不少忙。
examples.pinyin: Zhāng xiānsheng cháng bāng tàitai mǎi cài, xǐ yīfu, yàoshi bǐ tàitai zǎo xiàbān, hái huì bǎ wǎncān zuò hǎo, zhēn tǐtiē. Wǒ tóngxué hěn tǐtiē fùmǔ, jīngcháng zhǔfàn, zuò jiāshì, bāng le fùmǔ bùshǎo máng.
examples.english: Mr. Zhang often helps his wife buy groceries and wash clothes; if he gets off work earlier than his wife, he also makes dinner—he is truly considerate. My classmate is very considerate of his parents; he often cooks and does housework, helping his parents a lot.

examples.chinese: 購物時我喜歡一個人慢慢看，不太喜歡店員一直向我推銷。
examples.pinyin: Gòuwù shí wǒ xǐhuān yí ge rén mànmàn kàn, bú tài xǐhuān diànyuán yìzhí xiàng wǒ tuīxiāo.
examples.english: When shopping, I like to look around slowly by myself; I don't really like salesclerks constantly trying to sell to me.

examples.chinese: 李老闆是個很實在的人，他賣的包子不但好吃，餡料（xiànliào， filling）也很實在，難怪生意好得不得了。今天天氣實在太熱了，雖然夏天的電費很貴，我還是把冷氣打開了。
examples.pinyin: Lǐ lǎobǎn shì ge hěn shízài de rén, tā mài de bāozi búdàn hǎochī, xiànliào yě hěn shízài, nánguài shēngyì hǎo de bùdéliǎo. Jīntiān tiānqì shízài tài rè le, suīrán xiàtiān de diànfèi hěn guì, wǒ háishì bǎ lěngqì dǎkāi le.
examples.english: Boss Li is a very honest person; the steamed buns he sells are not only delicious, but the filling is also very generous—no wonder his business is incredibly good. Today the weather is really too hot; although summer electricity bills are expensive, I still turned on the air conditioner.

examples.chinese: 包小姐的眼光很好，一看就知道那件黃色外套的品質最好。妹妹：我希望將來找個又聰明又有錢 ，而且很體貼我的男朋友。 姊姊：妳的眼光太高了，恐怕找不到。
examples.pinyin: Bāo xiǎojiě de yǎnguāng hěn hǎo, yí kàn jiù zhīdào nà jiàn huángsè wàitào de pǐnzhí zuì hǎo. Mèimei: Wǒ xīwàng jiānglái zhǎo ge yòu cōngmíng yòu yǒu qián, érqiě hěn tǐtiē wǒ de nánpéngyou. Jiějie: Nǐ de yǎnguāng tài gāo le, kǒngpà zhǎo bú dào.
examples.english: Miss Bao has a good eye; she can tell at a glance that the quality of that yellow coat is the best. Younger sister: I hope to find a boyfriend in the future who is smart, rich, and very considerate of me. Older sister: Your standards are too high; I'm afraid you won't find one.

examples.chinese: 張太太上個月生了一個女兒，我寫了一張卡片祝福她，希望孩子快快樂樂地長大。 我的孩子滿月時，收到很多朋友送的禮物和滿滿的祝福。
examples.pinyin: Zhāng tàitai shàng ge yuè shēng le yí ge nǚ'ér, wǒ xiě le yì zhāng kǎpiàn zhùfú tā, xīwàng háizi kuàikuàilèlè de zhǎngdà. Wǒ de háizi mǎnyuè shí, shōudào hěn duō péngyou sòng de lǐwù hé mǎnmǎn de zhùfú.
examples.english: Mrs. Zhang gave birth to a daughter last month. I wrote a card to bless her, hoping the child will grow up happily. When my child was one month old, we received many gifts from friends and full blessings.

examples.chinese: 為了避免皮膚受傷，夏天出門時別忘了戴上帽子和太陽眼鏡。
examples.pinyin: Wèile bìmiǎn pífū shòushāng, xiàtiān chūmén shí bié wàng le dài shàng màozi hé tàiyáng yǎnjìng.
examples.english: To avoid skin injury, don't forget to put on a hat and sunglasses when going out in summer.

examples.chinese: 付錢的時候，他從皮包裡抽出一張信用卡交給店員。他參加百貨公司的活動，抽到一台價格六萬元的平板電腦， 真是太幸運了！
examples.pinyin: Fù qián de shíhou, tā cóng píbāo lǐ chōu chū yī zhāng xìnyòngkǎ jiāo gěi diànyuán. Tā cānjiā bǎihuò gōngsī de huódòng, chōu dào yī tái jiàgé liù wàn yuán de píngbǎn diànnǎo, zhēn shì tài xìngyùn le!
examples.english: When paying, he took out a credit card from his wallet and handed it to the clerk. He participated in a department store event and drew a tablet computer worth 60,000 yuan; he was really so lucky!

examples.chinese: 顏太太很會保養，母子兩人站在一起時，看起來就像一對姊弟。
examples.pinyin: Yán tàitai hěn huì bǎoyǎng, mǔzǐ liǎng rén zhàn zài yīqǐ shí, kàn qǐlái jiù xiàng yī duì zǐdì.
examples.english: Mrs. Yan is very good at maintaining her appearance; when the mother and son stand together, they look like a pair of siblings.

examples.chinese: 強烈的陽光對我們的眼睛不好，出門活動時最好戴上太陽眼鏡。
examples.pinyin: Qiángliè de yángguāng duì wǒmen de yǎnjing bù hǎo, chūmén huódòng shí zuìhǎo dài shàng tàiyáng yǎnjìng.
examples.english: Strong sunlight is bad for our eyes; when going out for activities, it's best to wear sunglasses.

examples.chinese: 那輛汽車突然從路口開了出來， 把我嚇了一跳。聽說經理後天就要離開公司了。 這個消息太突然了，大家一時沒辦法接受。
examples.pinyin: Nà liàng qìchē tūrán cóng lùkǒu kāi le chūlái, bǎ wǒ xià le yī tiào. Tīngshuō jīnglǐ hòutiān jiù yào líkāi gōngsī le. Zhège xiāoxi tài tūrán le, dàjiā yīshí méi bànfǎ jiēshòu.
examples.english: That car suddenly drove out from the intersection and startled me. I heard that the manager is leaving the company the day after tomorrow. This news is too sudden; everyone couldn't accept it for a moment.

examples.chinese: 這次的水災不僅淹了整條街，好幾家工廠也因為淹水沒辦法生產，真是太糟了！
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì de shuǐzāi bùjǐn yān le zhěng tiáo jiē, hǎo jǐ jiā gōngchǎng yě yīnwèi yānshuǐ méi bànfǎ shēngchǎn, zhēn shì tài zāo le!
examples.english: This flooding not only flooded the entire street, but several factories also couldn't produce because of the flooding—it's really too bad!

examples.chinese: 因為天氣太熱了，有一隻貓在車子底下休息，不肯離開。
examples.pinyin: Yīnwèi tiānqì tài rè le, yǒu yì zhī māo zài chēzi dǐxià xiūxi, bù kěn líkāi.
examples.english: Because the weather is too hot, a cat is resting under the car and refuses to leave.

examples.chinese: 那個小孩在這場大地震中失去了親人，實在太可憐了。
examples.pinyin: Nàge xiǎohái zài zhè chǎng dà dìzhèn zhōng shīqù le qīnrén, shízài tài kělián le.
examples.english: That child lost his family in this big earthquake; it's really too pitiful.

examples.chinese: 我不太喜歡流很多汗，所以不常跑步，比較喜歡在公園散步。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bù tài xǐhuān liú hěn duō hàn, suǒyǐ bù cháng pǎobù, bǐjiào xǐhuān zài gōngyuán sànbù.
examples.english: I don't really like to sweat a lot, so I don't run often; I prefer to take walks in the park.

examples.chinese: 小周才三十歲，就去過四十幾個國家，甚至去過一些又危險又刺激的地方，真是太酷了！
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Zhōu cái sānshí suì, jiù qùguò sìshí jǐ gè guójiā, shènzhì qùguò yīxiē yòu wēixiǎn yòu cìjī de dìfāng, zhēn shì tài kù le!
examples.english: Xiao Zhou is only thirty years old, but has already been to over forty countries, and even some dangerous and exciting places—that's really so cool!

examples.chinese: 太太：我今天很累，不想做飯。 先生：那就叫披薩好了。又快又不麻煩。
examples.pinyin: Tàitai: Wǒ jīntiān hěn lèi, bù xiǎng zuòfàn. Xiānsheng: Nà jiù jiào pīsà hǎo le. Yòu kuài yòu bù máfan.
examples.english: Wife: I'm very tired today, I don't want to cook. Husband: Then let's just order pizza. It's quick and not troublesome.

examples.chinese: 既然你不想衝浪，那就坐在海灘上曬曬太陽吧！
examples.pinyin: Jìrán nǐ bù xiǎng chōnglàng, nà jiù zuò zài hǎitān shàng shài shài tàiyáng ba!
examples.english: Since you don't want to surf, then just sit on the beach and soak up some sun!

examples.chinese: 小白喝了太多酒，已經醉了，不能讓他繼續喝了。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Bái hē le tài duō jiǔ, yǐjīng zuì le, bùnéng ràng tā jìxù hē le.
examples.english: Xiao Bai has drunk too much alcohol and is already drunk; we can't let him keep drinking.

examples.chinese: 我和朋友昨天去河邊露營， 我們試著在河裡抓魚，沒想到真的抓到了五條魚。金先生親眼見過警察在街上抓小偷，一個跑來跑去，一個追來追去，他覺得太刺激了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hé péngyǒu zuótiān qù hébiān lùyíng, wǒmen shìzhe zài hé lǐ zhuā yú, méi xiǎngdào zhēn de zhuā dào le wǔ tiáo yú. Jīn xiānsheng qīnyǎn jiàn guò jǐngchá zài jiē shàng zhuā xiǎotōu, yī ge pǎo lái pǎo qù, yī ge zhuī lái zhuī qù, tā juéde tài cìjī le.
examples.english: My friend and I went camping by the river yesterday; we tried to catch fish in the river, and unexpectedly, we really caught five fish. Mr. Jin has seen with his own eyes the police catching a thief on the street—one running back and forth, the other chasing back and forth—he thought it was too exciting.

examples.chinese: 那家民宿的地點實在太偏僻了，除了路不好走，附近也沒人住，想找個人問路都難。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā mínsù de dìdiǎn shízài tài piānpì le, chúle lù bù hǎo zǒu, fùjìn yě méi rén zhù, xiǎng zhǎo ge rén wèn lù dōu nán.
examples.english: That guesthouse's location is really too remote. Besides the road being hard to travel, there's no one living nearby either; it's hard even to find someone to ask for directions.

examples.chinese: 小在追求夢想的路上，別太在意別人說什麼，只要不斷地努力，就能夢想成真。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Zài zhuīqiú mèngxiǎng de lùshàng, bié tài zàiyì biérén shuō shénme, zhǐyào búduàn de nǔlì, jiù néng mèngxiǎng chéngzhēn.
examples.english: On the road of pursuing your dreams, don't care too much about what others say; as long as you keep working hard, your dreams can come true.

examples.chinese: 何先生的肩膀比較寬，這件襯衫他穿起來太緊了。
examples.pinyin: Hé xiānsheng de jiānbǎng bǐjiào kuān, zhè jiàn chènshān tā chuān qǐlái tài jǐn le.
examples.english: Mr. He's shoulders are rather wide; this shirt is too tight when he puts it on.

examples.chinese: 因為工作太忙的關係，夏小姐已經有一段時間沒上街購物了。
examples.pinyin: Yīnwèi gōngzuò tài máng de guānxì, Xià xiǎojiě yǐjīng yǒu yī duàn shíjiān méi shàngjiē gòuwù le.
examples.english: Because she is too busy with work, Miss Xia has not gone out shopping for some time.

examples.chinese: 那位老太太年紀大了，沒辦法照顧他的狗，所以想幫狗找個新主人。
examples.pinyin: Nà wèi lǎotàitai niánjì dà le, méi bànfǎ zhàogù tā de gǒu, suǒyǐ xiǎng bāng gǒu zhǎo ge xīn zhǔrén.
examples.english: That old lady is advanced in age and has no way to take care of her dog, so she wants to find a new owner for the dog.

examples.chinese: 這次的露營活動因為颱風辦不成了，可以說計畫永遠沒辦法趕上變化。張老闆開會開得太久，沒趕上飛機，只好花錢再買一張機票了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì de lùyíng huódòng yīnwèi táifēng bàn bù chéng le, kěyǐ shuō jìhuà yǒngyuǎn méi bànfǎ gǎnshàng biànhuà. Zhāng lǎobǎn kāihuì kāi de tài jiǔ, méi gǎnshàng fēijī, zhǐhǎo huā qián zài mǎi yī zhāng jīpiào le.
examples.english: This camping activity couldn't be held because of the typhoon; you could say that plans can never catch up with changes. Boss Zhang's meeting went on too long, and he didn't catch the plane, so he had no choice but to spend money to buy another ticket.

examples.chinese: 我覺得馬小姐找不到工作的原因不是自己的條件不夠好，是他太缺乏自信了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ juéde Mǎ xiǎojiě zhǎo bù dào gōngzuò de yuányīn bùshì zìjǐ de tiáojiàn bù gòu hǎo, shì tā tài quēfá zìxìn le.
examples.english: I think the reason Miss Ma can't find a job is not that her own qualifications aren't good enough, but that she lacks self-confidence too much.

examples.chinese: 王太太把全家照顧得非常好，王先生很感謝她對家庭的貢獻。每個大學生畢業後，都應該為社會貢獻自己的專業能力。
examples.pinyin: Wáng tàitai bǎ quánjiā zhàogù de fēicháng hǎo, Wáng xiānsheng hěn gǎnxiè tā duì jiātíng de gòngxiàn. Měi gè dàxuéshēng bìyè hòu, dōu yīnggāi wèi shèhuì gòngxiàn zìjǐ de zhuānyè nénglì.
examples.english: Mrs. Wang takes very good care of the whole family; Mr. Wang is very grateful for her contribution to the family. After every university student graduates, they should contribute their professional abilities to society.

examples.chinese: 我妹妹的個性太單純了，別人說什麼她都相信，難怪常吃虧。經理找你談話，只是單純地想了解你對新工作適不適應，你別緊張。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ mèimei de gèxìng tài dānchún le, biérén shuō shénme tā dōu xiāngxìn, nánguài cháng chīkuī. Jīnglǐ zhǎo nǐ tánhuà, zhǐshì dānchún de xiǎng liǎojiě nǐ duì xīn gōngzuò shì bù shì yìng, nǐ bié jǐnzhāng.
examples.english: My younger sister's personality is too pure; she believes whatever others say, no wonder she often gets taken advantage of. The manager wants to talk with you simply to understand whether you are adapting to the new job; don't be nervous.

examples.chinese: 張太太一個人管三個孩子，家裡大大小小的事情也是她負責的，太辛苦了。姊姊：下個星期就要大學考試了，你怎麼不用功念書，反而天天出去玩？ 弟弟：妳別管我，這是我自己的事。
examples.pinyin: Zhāng tàitai yī gè rén guǎn sān gè háizi, jiālǐ dàdàxiǎoxiǎo de shìqíng yě shì tā fùzé de, tài xīngkǔ le. Jiějie: Xià gè xīngqī jiù yào dàxué kǎoshì le, nǐ zěnme bù yònggōng niànshū, fǎn'ér tiāntiān chūqù wán? Dìdi: Nǐ bié guǎn wǒ, zhè shì wǒ zìjǐ de shì.
examples.english: Mrs. Zhang manages three children all by herself, and she is also responsible for all the big and small matters at home; it's too hard. Older sister: The university exam is next week; why aren't you studying hard, but instead going out to play every day? Younger brother: Don't manage me; this is my own business.

examples.chinese: 這次颱風引起的水災太嚴重，害大家一連五天沒有乾淨的水可以用。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì táifēng yǐnqǐ de shuǐzāi tài yánzhòng, hài dàjiā yīlián wǔ tiān méiyǒu gānjìng de shuǐ kěyǐ yòng.
examples.english: The flood caused by this typhoon was too serious, causing everyone to go five days in a row without clean water to use.

examples.chinese: 強烈颱風快來了，救災中心對民眾發出警告，為了自己的生命安全，絕對別去海邊。小游經常喝了酒還開車回家，太太警告他如果不改掉這個壞習慣，就要跟他離婚。
examples.pinyin: Qiángliè táifēng kuài lái le, jiùzāi zhōngxīn duì mínzhòng fāchū jǐnggào, wèile zìjǐ de shēngmìng ānquán, juéduì bié qù hǎibiān. Xiǎo Yóu jīngcháng hē le jiǔ hái kāichē huí jiā, tàitai jǐnggào tā rúguǒ bù gǎidiào zhège huài xíguàn, jiù yào gēn tā líhūn.
examples.english: A strong typhoon is coming soon; the disaster relief center issued a warning to the public: for your own safety, absolutely do not go to the beach. Xiao You often drives home after drinking; his wife warned him that if he doesn't change this bad habit, she will divorce him.

examples.chinese: 員工：謝謝您幫了我一個大忙，這個小禮物請您收下。 主管：你太客氣了！這點兒小事真的沒什麼。
examples.pinyin: Yuángōng: Xièxie nín bāng le wǒ yī gè dà máng, zhège xiǎo lǐwù qǐng nín shōuxià. Zhǔguǎn: Nǐ tài kèqì le! Zhè diǎnr xiǎoshì zhēn de méishénme.
examples.english: Employee: Thank you for doing me a big favor; please accept this small gift. Supervisor: You're too polite! This little thing really is nothing serious.

examples.chinese: 黃先生的腳因為車禍受了很嚴重的傷，醫生建議他不要做太激烈的運動。這場網球比賽打得很激烈，已經打了五個小時了，還不知道誰輸誰贏。
examples.pinyin: Huáng xiānsheng de jiǎo yīnwèi chēhuò shòule hěn yánzhòng de shāng, yīshēng jiànyì tā búyào zuò tài jīliè de yùndòng. Zhè chǎng wǎngqiú bǐsài dǎ de hěn jīliè, yǐjīng dǎle wǔ ge xiǎoshí le, hái bù zhīdào shéi shū shéi yíng.
examples.english: Mr. Huang's foot was seriously injured in a car accident; the doctor advised him not to do overly intense exercise. This tennis match is being played very fiercely; it has already been played for five hours, and it is still unknown who will lose and who will win.

examples.chinese: 要是你覺得這盤菜的味道太淡了，可以加一點醬料。
examples.pinyin: Yàoshi nǐ juéde zhè pán cài de wèidào tài dàn le, kěyǐ jiā yìdiǎn jiàngliào.
examples.english: If you feel this dish's flavor is too light, you can add a little sauce.

examples.chinese: 我是金東賢的戲迷，今天終於看到他本人，實在太開心了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ shì Jīn Dōngxián de xìmí, jīntiān zhōngyú kàndào tā běnrén, shízài tài kāixīn le.
examples.english: I am a fan of Kim Dong-hyun; today I finally saw him in person, and I am really so happy.

examples.chinese: 你們之間的誤會越來越深，要是不面對面說清楚，恐怕連朋友都當不成了。下課以後，老師幫我一對一補習數學，希望我的期末考會及格。昨天的歐洲足球賽，法國對義大利的比賽真是太刺激了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐmen zhījiān de wùhuì yuè lái yuè shēn, yàobùshì miànduìmiàn shuō qīngchǔ, kǒngpà lián péngyǒu dōu dāng bù chéng le. Xiàkè yǐhòu, lǎoshī bāng wǒ yī duì yī bǔxí shùxué, xīwàng wǒ de qīmòkǎo huì jígé. Zuótiān de Ōuzhōu zúqiúsài, Fǎguó duì Yìdàlì de bǐsài zhēn shì tài cìjī le.
examples.english: The misunderstanding between you two is getting deeper and deeper; if you don't talk it out face to face, I'm afraid you won't even be able to remain friends. After class, the teacher helped me with one-on-one math tutoring, hoping I will pass the final exam. Yesterday's European football match, France versus Italy, was really too exciting.

examples.chinese: 小章已經結婚了，還常常跟其他女生約會，真是太花心了。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Zhāng yǐjīng jiéhūn le, hái chángcháng gēn qítā nǚshēng yuēhuì, zhēn shì tài huāxīn le.
examples.english: Xiao Zhang is already married, yet he often dates other girls; he is really too womanizing.

examples.chinese: 石經理對員工很兇，回家後卻能表現出溫柔的一面，非常體貼太太。
examples.pinyin: Shí jīnglǐ duì yuángōng hěn xiōng, huíjiā hòu què néng biǎoxiàn chū wēnróu de yí miàn, fēicháng tǐtiē tàitai.
examples.english: Manager Shi is very fierce to employees, but after going home he can show a gentle aspect and is very considerate of his wife.

examples.chinese: 那個店員的工作態度很隨便，常弄錯商品的價格，還找錯錢， 真是太誇張了！
examples.pinyin: Nàge diànyuán de gōngzuò tàidù hěn suíbiàn, cháng nòngcuò shāngpǐn de jiàgé, hái zhǎo cuò qián, zhēn shì tài kuāzhāng le!
examples.english: That clerk's work attitude is very careless; he often gets the product prices wrong and also gives the wrong change—that's really too outrageous!

examples.chinese: 每當包太太心情不好的時候，包先生就會說笑話來逗她，讓她開心一點。
examples.pinyin: Měidāng Bāo tàitai xīnqíng bù hǎo de shíhou, Bāo xiānsheng jiù huì shuō xiàohua lái dòu tā, ràng tā kāixīn yìdiǎn.
examples.english: Whenever Mrs. Bao is in a bad mood, Mr. Bao will tell jokes to tease her and make her a little happier.

examples.chinese: 不知道明哲今天怎麼了？老師叫了他好幾次，他就像木頭一樣，沒有反應。九二一大地震發生得太突然，不少民眾因為來不及反應，而被困在屋裡。
examples.pinyin: Bù zhīdào Míngzhé jīntiān zěnme le? Lǎoshī jiào le tā hǎojǐ cì, tā jiù xiàng mùtou yíyàng, méiyǒu fǎnyìng. / Jiǔ'èr yī dà dìzhèn fāshēng de tài tūrán, bùshǎo mínzhòng yīnwèi láibují fǎnyìng, ér bèi kùn zài wū lǐ.
examples.english: I don't know what's wrong with Mingzhe today? The teacher called him several times, but he was like a piece of wood, without any reaction. / The 921 earthquake happened too suddenly; many people were trapped inside their houses because they didn't have time to react.

examples.chinese: 太太：你喝醉了，別再喝了。 先生：好啦，好啦，還剩下一口，喝完就不喝了。
examples.pinyin: Tàitai: Nǐ hē zuì le, bié zài hē le. Xiānsheng: Hǎo la, hǎo la, hái shèngxià yī kǒu, hē wán jiù bù hē le.
examples.english: Wife: You're drunk; don't drink anymore. Husband: Okay, okay, there's still one sip left; after I finish it, I won't drink anymore.

examples.chinese: A:我太糊塗了，忘了把變更後的網路銀行密碼記下來。 B:這下子你得親自去銀行處理了。
examples.pinyin: A: Wǒ tài hútu le, wàng le bǎ biàngēng hòu de wǎnglù yínháng mìmǎ jì xiàlái. B: Zhè xiàzi nǐ děi qīnzì qù yínháng chǔlǐ le.
examples.english: A: I was too careless and forgot to write down the changed internet banking password. B: Now you'll have to go to the bank in person to deal with it.

examples.chinese: 小簡今天遇到以前的女朋友，跟她喝了咖啡才回家，但不敢跟太太說實話。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Jiǎn jīntiān yùdào yǐqián de nǚpéngyǒu, gēn tā hē le kāfēi cái huí jiā, dàn bù gǎn gēn tàitai shuō shíhuà.
examples.english: Today Xiao Jian ran into his ex-girlfriend, and only went home after having coffee with her, but he didn't dare tell his wife the truth.

examples.chinese: 跟大人比起來，小孩子的想法比較單純、天真，不會故意騙人。A:網友跟我借十萬塊錢，說他的家人生病住院了。 B:你太天真了，他是騙你的。
examples.pinyin: 1. Gēn dàrén bǐ qǐlái, xiǎoháizi de xiǎngfǎ bǐjiào dānchún, tiānzhēn, bú huì gùyì piàn rén. 2. A: Wǎngyǒu gēn wǒ jiè shí wàn kuài qián, shuō tā de jiārén shēngbìng zhùyuàn le. B: Nǐ tài tiānzhēn le, tā shì piàn nǐ de.
examples.english: 1. Compared with adults, children's thinking is simpler and more innocent; they won't deliberately deceive people. 2. A: An online friend borrowed a hundred thousand dollars from me, saying his family member was sick and hospitalized. B: You're too naive; he's deceiving you.

examples.chinese: 媽媽實在太會做飯了，只用了一個小時就變出一桌既豐富又好吃的大餐。
examples.pinyin: Māma shízài tài huì zuòfàn le, zhǐ yòng le yí ge xiǎoshí jiù biàn chū yì zhuō jì fēngfù yòu hǎochī de dàcān.
examples.english: Mom is really too good at cooking; in just one hour, she conjured up a table full of both abundant and delicious feast.

examples.chinese: 我們在山上拿著攝影機，等著太陽升起，把美麗的日出時刻錄下來。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen zài shān shàng ná zhe shèyǐngjī, děng zhe tàiyáng shēng qǐ, bǎ měilì de rìchū shíkè lù xiàlái.
examples.english: We were on the mountain holding a video camera, waiting for the sun to rise, and recording the beautiful moment of sunrise.

examples.chinese: 我每次寫完考卷都會仔細檢查一遍，要是發現錯誤就馬上改過來。費太太結婚後才發現這是個錯誤決定，她不知道該怎麼辦才好。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ měi cì xiě wán kǎojuàn dōu huì zǐxì jiǎnchá yí biàn, yàoshi fāxiàn cuòwù jiù mǎshàng gǎi guòlái. Fèi tàitai jiéhūn hòu cái fāxiàn zhè shì ge cuòwù juédìng, tā bù zhīdào gāi zěnme bàn cái hǎo.
examples.english: Every time I finish writing an exam paper, I carefully check it once; if I find a mistake, I immediately correct it. Mrs. Fei only discovered after marriage that this was a wrong decision, and she doesn't know what to do.

examples.chinese: 這座古老的城市因為公共設備太舊，購物也不方便，不少人都搬走了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zuò gǔlǎo de chéngshì yīnwèi gōnggòng shèbèi tài jiù, gòuwù yě bù fāngbiàn, bùshǎo rén dōu bān zǒu le.
examples.english: Because this ancient city's public facilities are too old and shopping is also inconvenient, quite a few people have moved away.

examples.chinese: 張先生夫婦自從結婚以來，不曾吵過架，因為兩人的脾氣都太好了。
examples.pinyin: Zhāng xiānsheng fūfù zìcóng jiéhūn yǐlái, bùcéng chǎo guò jià, yīnwèi liǎng rén de píqi dōu tài hǎo le.
examples.english: Since Mr. and Mrs. Zhang got married, they have never had a fight, because both of their tempers are too good.

examples.chinese: 爸爸常教導我做人要謙虛，太驕傲的話，不僅讓人討厭，做事也可能不順利。
examples.pinyin: Bàba cháng jiàodǎo wǒ zuòrén yào qiānxū, tài jiāo'ào de huà, bùjǐn ràng rén tǎoyàn, zuòshì yě kěnéng bù shùnlì.
examples.english: Dad often teaches me to be modest. If you are too arrogant, not only will people dislike you, but things may not go smoothly either.

examples.chinese: 想要讓身體健康，得先注意飲食，少吃太油、太鹹的食物；其次要培養每天運動的好習慣。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎng yào ràng shēntǐ jiànkāng, děi xiān zhùyì yǐnshí, shǎo chī tài yóu, tài xián de shíwù; qícì yào péiyǎng měitiān yùndòng de hǎo xíguàn.
examples.english: If you want to be healthy, you must first pay attention to your diet and eat less greasy and salty food; secondly, you need to cultivate the good habit of exercising every day.

examples.chinese: A:我到底該怎麼做才能讓老闆滿意？ B:你太驕傲、個性太急， 做事也不夠仔細。總之， 先把自己的缺點改掉吧。
examples.pinyin: A: Wǒ dàodǐ gāi zěnme zuò cái néng ràng lǎobǎn mǎnyì? B: Nǐ tài jiāo'ào, gèxìng tài jí, zuòshì yě bù gòu zǐxì. Zǒngzhī, xiān bǎ zìjǐ de quēdiǎn gǎi diào ba.
examples.english: A: What on earth should I do to satisfy the boss? B: You are too arrogant, your personality is too impatient, and you are not careful enough in doing things. In short, first change your shortcomings.

examples.chinese: 這課的漢字我都認得，但還不太會寫，所以筆試時好些字都寫錯了。弟弟：爺爺怎麼常把我和你的名字搞錯？ 哥哥：爺爺年紀太大了，腦子不清楚，好像不認得我們了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè kè de Hànzì wǒ dōu rènde, dàn hái bù tài huì xiě, suǒyǐ bǐshì shí hǎoxiē zì dōu xiě cuò le. Dìdi: Yéye zěnme cháng bǎ wǒ hé nǐ de míngzi gǎo cuò? Gēge: Yéye niánjì tài dà le, nǎozi bù qīngchu, hǎoxiàng bù rènde wǒmen le.
examples.english: I can recognize all the Chinese characters in this lesson, but I am not yet able to write them well, so I wrote many characters incorrectly on the written test. Younger brother: Why does Grandpa often mix up your name and mine? Older brother: Grandpa is too old and his mind is unclear; it seems he no longer recognizes us.

examples.chinese: 有一些研究科學的人，對不科學、無法合理解釋的現象都不太相信。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu yìxiē yánjiū kēxué de rén, duì bù kēxué, wúfǎ hélǐ jiěshì de xiànxiàng dōu bú tài xiāngxìn.
examples.english: Some people who study science do not really believe in unscientific phenomena that cannot be reasonably explained.

examples.chinese: 最近天氣不太穩定，氣溫的變化很大，出門時最好帶把傘。
examples.pinyin: Zuìjìn tiānqì bú tài wěndìng, qìwēn de biànhuà hěn dà, chūmén shí zuìhǎo dài bǎ sǎn.
examples.english: The weather has been unstable recently, and the temperature changes a lot; when going out, it's best to bring an umbrella.

examples.chinese: 昨天棒球賽進行到一半時突然下起了大雨，雖然後來雨停了，但因為球場太溼，也無法繼續比賽了。
examples.pinyin: Zuótiān bàngqiúsài jìnxíng dào yíbàn shí tūrán xià qǐ le dàyǔ, suīrán hòulái yǔ tíng le, dàn yīnwèi qiúchǎng tài shī, yě wúfǎ jìxù bǐsài le.
examples.english: Yesterday, when the baseball game had proceeded to halfway, it suddenly started raining heavily. Although the rain stopped later, because the field was too wet, the game could not continue.

examples.chinese: 許多國家因為工業進步得太快，反而使得農業慢慢不被重視了。
examples.pinyin: Xǔduō guójiā yīnwèi gōngyè jìnbù de tài kuài, fǎn'ér shǐde nóngyè mànmàn bù bèi zhòngshì le.
examples.english: Because industry in many countries progressed too quickly, it instead made agriculture gradually not be valued.

examples.chinese: 大家都知道喝太多酒對身體沒有好處，但不少人仍然如此，甚至天天喝醉。淡水的夕陽很美，如此的美麗風景，是約會的極佳地點。
examples.pinyin: Dàjiā dōu zhīdào hē tài duō jiǔ duì shēntǐ méiyǒu hǎochù, dàn bùshǎo rén réngrán rúcǐ, shènzhì tiāntiān hē zuì. Dànshuǐ de xīyáng hěn měi, rúcǐ de měilì fēngjǐng, shì yuēhuì de jíjiā dìdiǎn.
examples.english: Everyone knows that drinking too much alcohol is not good for the body, but many people still do so, and even get drunk every day. The sunset in Tamsui is very beautiful; such a beautiful scenery is an excellent place for a date.

examples.chinese: 我會游泳，可是游得不太好。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ huì yóuyǒng, kěshì yóu de bú tài hǎo.
examples.english: I can swim, but not very well.

examples.chinese: 可是我覺得那裡有點兒遠，走路去太累了。
examples.pinyin: Kěshì wǒ juéde nàlǐ yǒudiǎnr yuǎn, zǒulù qù tài lèi le.
examples.english: But I think it’s a bit far. It’s too tiring to get there on foot.

examples.chinese: 都太短，也太小了。
examples.pinyin: Dōu tài duǎn, yě tài xiǎo le.
examples.english: They are both too short and too small.

examples.chinese: 友美，這幾個句子的意思我不太懂，妳可以教我嗎？
examples.pinyin: Yǒuměi, zhè jǐ ge jùzi de yìsi wǒ bú tài dǒng, nǐ kěyǐ jiāo wǒ ma?
examples.english: Youmei, I don’t quite understand these sentences. Could you teach me?

examples.chinese: 我覺得有點兒難，我也不太懂。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ juéde yǒudiǎnr nán, wǒ yě bú tài dǒng.
examples.english: It is a little bit difficult; I don’t quite understand them, either.

examples.chinese: 太好了！在那裡看書很舒服。我們每天都能用那間教室嗎？
examples.pinyin: Tài hǎo le! Zài nàlǐ kànshū hěn shūfu. Wǒmen měi tiān dōu néng yòng nà jiān jiàoshì ma?
examples.english: That’s awesome! Studying there is very comfortable. Can we use it every day?

examples.english: Speaking Chinese is easy, and singing Chinese songs is not difficult either.

examples.english: Speaking Chinese is easy, and singing Chinese songs is not difficult either.

examples.chinese: 弟弟不喜歡唱歌，因為怕唱得不好。
examples.pinyin: Dìdi bù xǐhuān chànggē, yīnwèi pà chàng de bù hǎo.
examples.english: My younger brother doesn't like singing because he is afraid of singing badly.

examples.chinese: A:你什麼時候有空？要不要跟我去唱歌？ B:我今天下午有空。
examples.pinyin: A: Nǐ shénme shíhou yǒu kòng? Yào bú yào gēn wǒ qù chànggē? B: Wǒ jīntiān xiàwǔ yǒu kòng.
examples.english: A: When are you free? Do you want to go sing with me? B: I'm free this afternoon.

examples.chinese: A:你今天唱歌唱得真好聽？ B:因為我心情很好。
examples.pinyin: A: Nǐ jīntiān chànggē chàng de zhēn hǎotīng? B: Yīnwèi wǒ xīnqíng hěn hǎo.
examples.english: A: You sang really beautifully today! B: Because I'm in a very good mood.

examples.chinese: 大華為了參加唱歌比賽，除了每天不斷地練習，也把自己唱的歌錄下來聽一聽，希望能唱得更好。雖然陸先生這幾年工作機會不斷，但是因為身體不好的關係一直沒辦法去上班。
examples.pinyin: Dàhuá wèile cānjiā chànggē bǐsài, chúle měitiān bùduàn de liànxí, yě bǎ zìjǐ chàng de gē lù xiàlái tīng yī tīng, xīwàng néng chàng de gèng hǎo. Suīrán Lù xiānsheng zhè jǐ nián gōngzuò jīhuì bùduàn, dànshì yīnwèi shēntǐ bù hǎo de guānxi yīzhí méi bànfǎ qù shàngbān.
examples.english: In order to participate in the singing competition, Dahua not only practices continuously every day, but also records his own singing to listen to, hoping to sing better. Although Mr. Lu has had continuous job opportunities these past few years, because of poor health he has never been able to go to work.

examples.chinese: 過年回家吃年夜飯，大家吃著吃著，就喝起酒來了，每喝幾杯，就唱一首歌，熱鬧極了。
examples.pinyin: Guònián huí jiā chī niányèfàn, dàjiā chī zhe chī zhe, jiù hē qǐ jiǔ lái le, měi hē jǐ bēi, jiù chàng yì shǒu gē, rènao jí le.
examples.english: When we go home for Chinese New Year to eat the New Year's Eve dinner, as everyone eats and eats, they start drinking; every few cups, they sing a song—it's extremely lively.

examples.chinese: 這首歌很受歡迎，被認為是今年的最佳歌曲。
examples.pinyin: Zhè shǒu gē hěn shòu huānyíng, bèi rènwéi shì jīnnián de zuìjiā gēqǔ.
examples.english: This song is very popular and is considered the best song of the year.

examples.chinese: 老師把安養院社團的社員分成兩個小組，第一組陪老人唱歌， 第二組陪老人玩遊戲。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī bǎ ānyǎngyuàn shètuán de shèyuán fēnchéng liǎng ge xiǎozǔ, dì-yī zǔ péi lǎorén chànggē, dì-èr zǔ péi lǎorén wán yóuxì.
examples.english: The teacher divided the members of the nursing home club into two groups: the first group sang songs with the elderly, and the second group played games with the elderly.

examples.chinese: 《生日快樂》是全世界著名的歌曲，不同國家的人也能用自己的語言唱出來。
examples.pinyin: 《Shēngrì Kuàilè》 shì quán shìjiè zhùmíng de gēqǔ, bùtóng guójiā de rén yě néng yòng zìjǐ de yǔyán chàng chūlái.
examples.english: "Happy Birthday" is a world-famous song; people from different countries can also sing it in their own languages.

examples.chinese: 李先生的女朋友又溫柔又客氣。
examples.pinyin: Lǐ xiānsheng de nǚpéngyou yòu wēnróu yòu kèqi.
examples.english: Mr. Li's girlfriend is both gentle and polite.

examples.chinese: 李先生的女朋友又溫柔又客氣。
examples.pinyin: Lǐ xiānsheng de nǚpéngyou yòu wēnróu yòu kèqi.
examples.english: Mr. Li's girlfriend is both gentle and polite.

examples.chinese: 一般人都喜歡跟性格溫柔、樂觀的人交朋友。
examples.pinyin: Yībān rén dōu xǐhuān gēn xìnggé wēnróu, lèguān de rén jiāo péngyǒu.
examples.english: Most people like to make friends with people who have a gentle and optimistic personality.

examples.chinese: 何小姐地個性溫柔，笑起來也很迷人，所以追求她的人很多。
examples.pinyin: Hé xiǎojiě de gèxìng wēnróu, xiào qǐlái yě hěn mírén, suǒyǐ zhuīqiú tā de rén hěn duō.
examples.english: Miss He has a gentle personality and her smile is very charming, so many people pursue her.

examples.chinese: 石經理對員工很兇，回家後卻能表現出溫柔的一面，非常體貼太太。
examples.pinyin: Shí jīnglǐ duì yuángōng hěn xiōng, huíjiā hòu què néng biǎoxiàn chū wēnróu de yí miàn, fēicháng tǐtiē tàitai.
examples.english: Manager Shi is very fierce to employees, but after going home he can show a gentle aspect and is very considerate of his wife.

examples.chinese: 老謝溫柔體貼、聰明英俊，符合我結婚對象的條件，因此我答應嫁給他。
examples.pinyin: Lǎo Xiè wēnróu tǐtiē, cōngmíng yīngjùn, fúhé wǒ jiéhūn duìxiàng de tiáojiàn, yīncǐ wǒ dāyìng jià gěi tā.
examples.english: Old Xie is gentle and considerate, smart and handsome, and meets the conditions for my marriage partner; therefore, I agreed to marry him.

examples.chinese: A:江先生對父母很孝順，個性又溫柔，將來一定是好先生。B:這還用說嗎？要是妳對他有意思，就得早點兒行動喔！
examples.pinyin: A: Jiāng xiānsheng duì fùmǔ hěn xiàoshùn, gèxìng yòu wēnróu, jiānglái yīdìng shì hǎo xiānsheng. B: Zhè hái yòng shuō ma? Yàoshi nǐ duì tā yǒu yìsi, jiù děi zǎo diǎnr xíngdòng o!
examples.english: A: Mr. Jiang is very filial to his parents and has a gentle personality; in the future he will definitely be a good husband. B: You're telling me! If you're interested in him, you'd better make a move early!

examples.chinese: 滑雪是很刺激的活動，需要很好的技巧。李小姐受不了離婚的刺激，已經好幾天吃不好、睡不好了。
examples.pinyin: Huáxuě shì hěn cìjī de huódòng, xūyào hěn hǎo de jìqiǎo. Lǐ xiǎojiě shòu bù liǎo líhūn de cìjī, yǐjīng hǎo jǐ tiān chī bù hǎo, shuì bù hǎo le.
examples.english: Skiing is a very exciting activity that requires good skills. Miss Li couldn't handle the shock of divorce, and has been unable to eat or sleep well for several days.

examples.chinese: 張先生滑雪的技巧很好，這次比賽他有信心能夠得到前三名。
examples.pinyin: Zhāng xiānsheng huáxuě de jìqiǎo hěn hǎo, zhè cì bǐsài tā yǒu xìnxīn nénggòu dédào qián sān míng.
examples.english: Mr. Zhang's skiing skills are very good; for this competition, he has confidence that he can get into the top three.

examples.chinese: 樂團主唱的唱歌技巧，對樂團演出表現的影響相當大。
examples.pinyin: Yuètuán zhǔchàng de chànggē jìqiǎo, duì yuètuán yǎnchū biǎoxiàn de yǐngxiǎng xiāngdāng dà.
examples.english: The lead vocalist's singing skills have a considerable impact on the band's performance.

examples.chinese: 章小姐接觸電影表演工作不久，雖然還是新人，對表演技巧倒是掌握得挺好的。
examples.pinyin: Zhāng xiǎojiě jiēchù diànyǐng biǎoyǎn gōngzuò bùjiǔ, suīrán hái shì xīnrén, duì biǎoyǎn jìqiǎo dàoshì zhǎngwò de tǐng hǎo de.
examples.english: Miss Zhang has not been involved in film acting for long; although she is still a newcomer, she has actually mastered acting techniques quite well.

examples.chinese: 接待客戶是有技巧的，弄不好可能會丟了生意。
examples.pinyin: Jiēdài kèhù shì yǒu jìqiǎo de, nòng bù hǎo kěnéng huì diū le shēngyì.
examples.english: Receiving clients requires skill; if you don't handle it well, you might lose the business.

examples.chinese: 擲標槍、射箭、開槍(to shoot)需要的技巧都不同，想熟練就得多連練習。
examples.pinyin: Zhì biāoqiāng, shèjiàn, kāiqiāng xūyào de jìqiǎo dōu bùtóng, xiǎng shúliàn jiù děi duō liànxí.
examples.english: The skills required for javelin throwing, archery, and shooting a gun are all different; if you want to become proficient, you must practice more.

examples.chinese: 訓練出著名跳高選手的教練認為，要跳得高，技巧很重要。
examples.pinyin: Xùnliàn chū zhùmíng tiàogāo xuǎnshǒu de jiàoliàn rènwéi, yào tiào de gāo, jìqiǎo hěn zhòngyào.
examples.english: The coach who trained a famous high jump athlete believes that to jump high, technique is very important.

examples.chinese: 我們學校的啦啦隊隊員個子都很高，舞蹈的技巧也很出色。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen xuéxiào de lālāduì duìyuán gèzi dōu hěn gāo, wǔdǎo de jìqiǎo yě hěn chūsè.
examples.english: The cheerleading team members of our school are all very tall, and their dance skills are also excellent.

examples.chinese: 王教授推薦我去念那個研究所的翻譯課程。
examples.pinyin: Wáng jiàoshòu tuījiàn wǒ qù niàn nàge yánjiūsuǒ de fānyì kèchéng.
examples.english: Professor Wang recommended that I go study the translation course at that graduate institute.

examples.chinese: 那所雙語學校強調，除了中文課以外，其他的課程都是用英文上的。
examples.pinyin: Nà suǒ shuāngyǔ xuéxiào qiángdiào, chúle Zhōngwén kè yǐwài, qítā de kèchéng dōu shì yòng Yīngwén shàng de.
examples.english: That bilingual school emphasizes that, except for Chinese classes, all other courses are taught in English.

examples.chinese: 華語中心除了有培養學生中文能力的課程，還安排了文化課，讓課程更豐富。
examples.pinyin: Huáyǔ zhōngxīn chúle yǒu péiyǎng xuéshēng Zhōngwén nénglì de kèchéng, hái ānpái le wénhuà kè, ràng kèchéng gèng fēngfù.
examples.english: The Mandarin center, besides having courses that develop students' Chinese ability, also arranged culture classes, making the courses richer.

examples.chinese: 為了配合藝術課程的內容，黃老師帶領學生去參觀博物館和美術館。
examples.pinyin: Wèile pèihé yìshù kèchéng de nèiróng, Huáng lǎoshī dàilǐng xuésheng qù cānguān bówùguǎn hé měishùguǎn.
examples.english: In order to fit the content of the art course, Teacher Huang led the students to visit the museum and the art gallery.

examples.chinese: 只要照溫老師安排的課程，多閱讀、多練習，你的中文就會有很大的進步。
examples.pinyin: Zhǐyào zhào Wēn lǎoshī ānpái de kèchéng, duō yuèdú, duō liànxí, nǐ de Zhōngwén jiù huì yǒu hěn dà de jìnbù.
examples.english: As long as you follow the curriculum arranged by Teacher Wen, read more and practice more, your Chinese will make great progress.

examples.chinese: 老師先把跟課程相關的學習資料上傳到雲端，讓學生預習。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī xiān bǎ gēn kèchéng xiāngguān de xuéxí zīliào shàngchuán dào yúnduān, ràng xuéshēng yùxí.
examples.english: The teacher first uploads the course-related learning materials to the cloud for students to preview.

examples.chinese: 他很聰明，成績又非常好，因此完成初級班的課程後，學校讓他跳過中級，到高級班學習，一連跳了兩級。
examples.pinyin: Tā hěn cōngmíng, chéngjì yòu fēicháng hǎo, yīncǐ wánchéng chūjí bān de kèchéng hòu, xuéxiào ràng tā tiàoguò zhōngjí, dào gāojí bān xuéxí, yīlián tiào le liǎng jí.
examples.english: He is very smart and his grades are also excellent, so after completing the beginner-level class curriculum, the school let him skip the intermediate level and study in the advanced class—he skipped two levels in a row.

examples.chinese: 今天的自然科學課程所介紹的主題是月球的構造。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān de zìrán kēxué kèchéng suǒ jièshào de zhǔtí shì yuèqiú de gòuzào.
examples.english: The topic introduced in today's natural science course is the structure of the moon.

examples.chinese: 如果您對學校課程有任何問題，歡迎至辦公室談談。
examples.pinyin: Rúguǒ nín duì xuéxiào kèchéng yǒu rènhé wèntí, huānyíng zhì bàngōngshì tántán.
examples.english: If you have any questions about the school curriculum, you are welcome to come to the office to talk.

examples.chinese: 她推動學習革命，讓學生主動參與規劃課程。
examples.pinyin: Tā tuīdòng xuéxí gémìng, ràng xuéshēng zhǔdòng cānyǔ guīhuà kèchéng.
examples.english: She promoted a learning revolution, letting students actively participate in planning the curriculum.

examples.chinese: 科學家發明了電燈，改變了人類的生活方式，也大大提高了生活品質。網路是很偉大的發明，就算不出門，也能讓人們得到全球各地的訊息。
examples.pinyin: Kēxuéjiā fāmíng le diàndēng, gǎibiàn le rénlèi de shēnghuó fāngshì, yě dàdà tígāo le shēnghuó pǐnzhí. Wǎnglù shì hěn wěidà de fāmíng, jiùsuàn bù chūmén, yě néng ràng rénmen dédào quánqiú gèdì de xùnxí.
examples.english: Scientists invented the electric light, which changed the lifestyle of mankind and also greatly improved the quality of life. The Internet is a great invention; even without going out, it can let people get information from all over the world.

examples.chinese: 陳老師為了引起學生的學習興趣，每次上課前都會準備一些有趣的遊戲。
examples.pinyin: Chén lǎoshī wèile yǐnqǐ xuéshēng de xuéxí xìngqù, měi cì shàngkè qián dōu huì zhǔnbèi yīxiē yǒuqù de yóuxì.
examples.english: In order to arouse the students' interest in learning, Teacher Chen prepares some interesting games before every class.

examples.chinese: 在山上烤肉時要非常注意，一不小心就可能引起森林火災。
examples.pinyin: Zài shānshàng kǎoròu shí yào fēicháng zhùyì, yī bù xiǎoxīn jiù kěnéng yǐnqǐ sēnlín huǒzāi.
examples.english: When having a barbecue in the mountains, you must be very careful; if you are not careful, it may cause a forest fire.

examples.chinese: 這次颱風引起的水災太嚴重，害大家一連五天沒有乾淨的水可以用。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì táifēng yǐnqǐ de shuǐzāi tài yánzhòng, hài dàjiā yīlián wǔ tiān méiyǒu gānjìng de shuǐ kěyǐ yòng.
examples.english: The flood caused by this typhoon was too serious, causing everyone to go five days in a row without clean water to use.

examples.chinese: 儘管他沒主持過什麼節目，他的獨特風格仍然引起大家注意。
examples.pinyin: Jǐnguǎn tā méi zhǔchí guò shénme jiémù, tā de dútè fēnggé réngrán yǐnqǐ dàjiā zhùyì.
examples.english: Although he has never hosted any programs, his unique style still attracted everyone's attention.

examples.chinese: 國內外的社會運動，經常都是因為人民的意見不被尊重而引起的。
examples.pinyin: Guónèi wài de shèhuì yùndòng, jīngcháng dōu shì yīnwèi rénmín de yìjiàn bù bèi zūnjìng ér yǐnqǐ de.
examples.english: Social movements at home and abroad are often caused because people's opinions are not respected.

examples.chinese: 一小部分人引起的戰爭使人民付出了相當大的代價。
examples.pinyin: Yī xiǎo bùfèn rén yǐnqǐ de zhànzhēng shǐ rénmín fùchū le xiāngdāng dà de dàijià.
examples.english: The war caused by a small group of people made the people pay a considerable price.

examples.chinese: 根據美國某項研究資料，青少年因腦震盪而被送到醫院的意外中，超過一半是因為激烈運動引起的。
examples.pinyin: Gēnjù Měiguó mǒu xiàng yánjiū zīliào, qīngshàonián yīn nǎozhèndàng ér bèi sòng dào yīyuàn de yìwài zhōng, chāoguò yībàn shì yīnwèi jīliè yùndòng yǐnqǐ de.
examples.english: According to a certain American research study, among accidents in which teenagers are sent to the hospital due to cerebral concussion, more than half are caused by intense sports.

items.wordHook: Combining 引(pull) and 起(begin): 引起 means cause.

examples.chinese: 阿姨的婚禮明天下午兩點在教堂舉行，這個重要時刻我一定不能遲到。
examples.pinyin: Āyí de hūnlǐ míngtiān xiàwǔ liǎng diǎn zài jiàotáng jǔxíng, zhège zhòngyào shíkè wǒ yīdìng bùnéng chídào.
examples.english: Auntie's wedding will be held at the church at two o'clock tomorrow afternoon; I absolutely must not be late for this important moment.

examples.chinese: 我們在山上拿著攝影機，等著太陽升起，把美麗的日出時刻錄下來。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen zài shān shàng ná zhe shèyǐngjī, děng zhe tàiyáng shēng qǐ, bǎ měilì de rìchū shíkè lù xiàlái.
examples.english: We were on the mountain holding a video camera, waiting for the sun to rise, and recording the beautiful moment of sunrise.

examples.chinese: 有人一天到晚總看著手機，連錯過了精彩的生活時刻也不知道。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu rén yìtiāndàowǎn zǒng kànzhe shǒujī, lián cuòguòle jīngcǎi de shēnghuó shíkè yě bù zhīdào.
examples.english: Some people always look at their phones from morning till night, and don't even know when they've missed wonderful moments in life.

examples.chinese: 當你面臨困難或挑戰時，也正是表現個人智慧與能力的最佳時刻。
examples.pinyin: Dāng nǐ miànlín kùnnán huò tiǎozhàn shí, yě zhèng shì biǎoxiàn gèrén zhìhuì yǔ nénglì de zuì jiā shíkè.
examples.english: When you face difficulties or challenges, it is also exactly the best moment to demonstrate personal wisdom and ability.

items.wordHook: Combining 時(time) and 刻(carve): 時刻 means moment, time.

examples.chinese: 姊姊有了自己的孩子以後，才體會到當父母是很辛苦的。
examples.pinyin: Jiějie yǒu le zìjǐ de háizi yǐhòu, cái tǐhuì dào dāng fùmǔ shì hěn xīnkǔ de.
examples.english: Only after having her own child did my older sister realize that being a parent is very hard.

examples.chinese: 吃太多炸的東西，對身體會有不好的影響。
examples.pinyin: Chī tài duō zhà de dōngxi, duì shēntǐ huì yǒu bù hǎo de yǐngxiǎng.
examples.english: Eating too much fried food will have a bad influence on your health.

examples.chinese: 只有勇敢面對挑戰、克服困難的人，才能深深體會到成就感帶來的快樂。
examples.pinyin: Zhǐyǒu yǒnggǎn miànduì tiǎozhàn, kèfú kùnnán de rén, cái néng shēnshēn tǐhuì dào chéngjiùgǎn dàilái de kuàilè.
examples.english: Only those who bravely face challenges and overcome difficulties can deeply experience the happiness that a sense of accomplishment brings.

examples.chinese: 這面牆壁上的圖畫真美，是誰畫的？
examples.pinyin: Zhè miàn qiángbì shàng de túhuà zhēn měi, shì shéi huà de?
examples.english: The picture on this wall is really beautiful—who painted it?

examples.chinese: 每年大學迎新時，學校總是會辦舞會歡迎大家。
examples.pinyin: Měi nián dàxué yíngxīn shí, xuéxiào zǒngshì huì bàn wǔhuì huānyíng dàjiā.
examples.english: Every year during the university orientation, the school always holds a dance to welcome everyone.

examples.chinese: 大家都歡迎新老師到我們學校來。
examples.pinyin: Dàjiā dōu huānyíng xīn lǎoshī dào wǒmen xuéxiào lái.
examples.english: Everyone welcomes the new teacher to come to our school.

examples.chinese: 姊姊覺得木頭地板很麻煩，因為得跪著擦才擦得乾淨。
examples.pinyin: Jiějie juéde mùtou dìbǎn hěn máfan, yīnwèi děi guì zhe cā cái cā de gānjìng.
examples.english: My older sister thinks wooden floors are troublesome because you have to kneel to wipe them to get them clean.

examples.chinese: 所謂「人助天助」的意思，就是得自己先努力，天(God,Heavens)才會幫助你。
examples.pinyin: Suǒwèi “rén zhù tiān zhù” de yìsi, jiù shì děi zìjǐ xiān nǔlì, tiān cái huì bāngzhù nǐ.
examples.english: The so-called meaning of 'people help, Heaven helps' is that you must first work hard yourself, and only then will Heaven help you.

examples.chinese: 在這家餐廳，沒有人替你服務，點菜、拿碗筷等一切都得自助。
examples.pinyin: Zài zhè jiā cāntīng, méiyǒu rén tì nǐ fúwù, diǎncài, ná wǎnkuài děng yīqiè dōu děi zìzhù.
examples.english: In this restaurant, no one serves you; ordering dishes, getting bowls and chopsticks, and everything else must be self-service.

examples.chinese: 旅行團的行程及路線是公司及導遊決定的，不喜歡的話，就只能自助旅遊了。
examples.pinyin: Lǚxíngtuán de xíngchéng jí lùxiàn shì gōngsī jí dǎoyóu juédìng de, bù xǐhuān de huà, jiù zhǐ néng zìzhù lǚyóu le.
examples.english: The itinerary and route of a tour group are decided by the company and the tour guide; if you don't like it, then you can only travel independently.

examples.chinese: 參加旅行團或自助旅遊各有各的優點，懶得自己安排行程的人，就跟著導遊走吧。
examples.pinyin: Cānjiā lǚxíngtuán huò zìzhù lǚyóu gè yǒu gè de yōudiǎn, lǎn de zìjǐ ānpái xíngchéng de rén, jiù gēnzhe dǎoyóu zǒu ba.
examples.english: Joining a tour group or traveling independently each has its own advantages; those who are too lazy to arrange their own itinerary should just follow the tour guide.

examples.chinese: 我去澳洲登山時，碰見了正在自助旅行的老朋友，真巧！
examples.pinyin: Wǒ qù Àozhōu dēngshān shí, pèngjiàn le zhèngzài zìzhù lǚxíng de lǎo péngyou, zhēn qiǎo!
examples.english: When I went mountain climbing in Australia, I ran into an old friend who was traveling independently—what a coincidence!

examples.chinese: 我考慮接受公司的安排，到國外協助市場調查工作。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ kǎolǜ jiēshòu gōngsī de ānpái, dào guówài xiézhù shìchǎng diàochá gōngzuò.
examples.english: I am considering accepting the company's arrangement to go abroad to assist with market research work.

examples.chinese: 我覺得跳舞這項活動對健康很有幫助，還可以交到很多朋友。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ juéde tiàowǔ zhè xiàng huódòng duì jiànkāng hěn yǒu bāngzhù, hái kěyǐ jiāo dào hěn duō péngyǒu.
examples.english: I think the activity of dancing is very helpful for health, and you can also make many friends.

examples.chinese: 在臺灣，碰到緊急情況可撥110，請警察提供協助。
examples.pinyin: Zài Táiwān, pèngdào jǐnjí qíngkuàng kě bō 110, qǐng jǐngchá tígōng xiézhù.
examples.english: In Taiwan, when encountering an emergency, you can dial 110 to ask the police for assistance.

examples.chinese: 我想加入社會服務組織，幫助別人的同時也讓自己成長。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng jiārù shèhuì fúwù zǔzhī, bāngzhù biérén de tóngshí yě ràng zìjǐ chéngzhǎng.
examples.english: I want to join a social service organization; while helping others, I can also let myself grow.

examples.chinese: 對我來說，幸福就是在身邊有一群願意互相幫助的好友。
examples.pinyin: Duì wǒ lái shuō, xìngfú jiùshì zài shēnbiān yǒu yī qún yuànyì hùxiāng bāngzhù de hǎoyǒu.
examples.english: To me, happiness is having a group of good friends around who are willing to help each other.

examples.chinese: 為了愛惜食物資源，同時也幫助生活困難的家庭，張老闆決定在國內開幾家食物銀行。
examples.pinyin: Wèile àixī shíwù zīyuán, tóngshí yě bāngzhù shēnghuó kùnnán de jiātíng, Zhāng lǎobǎn juédìng zài guónèi kāi jǐ jiā shíwù yínháng.
examples.english: In order to cherish food resources and at the same time help families with financial difficulties, Boss Zhang decided to open several food banks in the country.

examples.chinese: 那位業務員不但謙虛而且誠實，你有需要的話可以請他協助。
examples.pinyin: Nà wèi yèwùyuán bùdàn qiānxū érqiě chéngshí, nǐ yǒu xūyào de huà kěyǐ qǐng tā xiézhù.
examples.english: That salesman is not only modest but also honest; if you need anything, you can ask him for assistance.

examples.chinese: 像食物銀行、愛心冰箱此類處理食物的做法，不但可以節省資源，還能幫助需要的人。
examples.pinyin: Xiàng shíwù yínháng, àixīn bīngxiāng cǐ lèi chǔlǐ shíwù de zuòfǎ, bùdàn kěyǐ jiéshěng zīyuán, hái néng bāngzhù xūyào de rén.
examples.english: This kind of approach to handling food, such as food banks and love refrigerators, not only can save resources but also can help people in need.

examples.chinese: 當鄰居生活遇到困難時，老馬總是主動提供協助，真令人感動。
examples.pinyin: Dāng línjū shēnghuó yùdào kùnnán shí, Lǎo Mǎ zǒngshì zhǔdòng tígōng xiézhù, zhēn lìng rén gǎndòng.
examples.english: When neighbors encounter difficulties in life, Old Ma always proactively offers assistance; it truly makes one moved.

examples.chinese: 從六○年代開始，臺灣就提供農業方面的協助給許多國家，這點讓我覺得很驕傲。
examples.pinyin: Cóng liù○ niándài kāishǐ, Táiwān jiù tígōng nóngyè fāngmiàn de xiézhù gěi xǔduō guójiā, zhè diǎn ràng wǒ juéde hěn jiāo'ào.
examples.english: Starting from the 1960s, Taiwan has provided assistance in agriculture to many countries; this point makes me feel very proud.

examples.chinese: 外國人在臺灣生活期間，如果遇到任何問題，都可以打0800-024111，請求協助。那個壞人殺了人，他知道自己錯了，到教堂去請求上帝原諒。
examples.pinyin: 1. Wàiguórén zài Táiwān shēnghuó qījiān, rúguǒ yùdào rènhé wèntí, dōu kěyǐ dǎ 0800-024111, qǐngqiú xiézhù. 2. Nàge huàirén shā le rén, tā zhīdào zìjǐ cuò le, dào jiàotáng qù qǐngqiú Shàngdì yuánliàng.
examples.english: 1. During their time living in Taiwan, if foreigners encounter any problems, they can call 0800-024111 to request assistance. 2. That bad person killed someone; he knew he was wrong and went to church to beg God for forgiveness.

examples.chinese: 剛進公司的員工對環境比較陌生，對工作內容也不熟悉，多多少少需要協助。
examples.pinyin: Gāng jìn gōngsī de yuángōng duì huánjìng bǐjiào mòshēng, duì gōngzuò nèiróng yě bù shúxī, duōduōshǎoshǎo xūyào xiézhù.
examples.english: Employees who have just joined the company are relatively unfamiliar with the environment and are also not familiar with the work content, so they more or less need assistance.

examples.chinese: 假如貴公司想擴大生產規模，可以參考本公司的作法，我們很願意提供協助。
examples.pinyin: Jiǎrú guì gōngsī xiǎng kuòdà shēngchǎn guīmó, kěyǐ cānkǎo běn gōngsī de zuòfǎ, wǒmen hěn yuànyì tígōng xiézhù.
examples.english: If your honorable company wants to expand production scale, you can refer to our company's methods; we are very willing to provide assistance.

examples.chinese: 當我遇到挫折時，他總是協助我克服困難，我們之間也建立了珍貴的友誼。
examples.pinyin: Dāng wǒ yùdào cuòzhé shí, tā zǒngshì xiézhù wǒ kèfú kùnnán, wǒmen zhījiān yě jiànlì le zhēnguì de yǒuyì.
examples.english: When I encounter setbacks, he always helps me overcome difficulties, and we have also established a precious friendship between us.

examples.chinese: A:要不是你幫忙，現在我還找不到工作呢！ B:沒什麼，朋友之間本來就應該互相幫助。
examples.pinyin: A: Yàobùshì nǐ bāngmáng, xiànzài wǒ hái zhǎo bù dào gōngzuò ne! B: Méi shénme, péngyǒu zhījiān běnlái jiù yīnggāi hùxiāng bāngzhù.
examples.english: A: If it weren't for your help, I still wouldn't have found a job now! B: It's nothing; between friends, we should help each other by nature.

examples.chinese: 這場大地震發生後不久，軍人就立刻趕到了災區，協助救災工作。
examples.pinyin: Zhè chǎng dà dìzhèn fāshēng hòu bùjiǔ, jūnrén jiù lìkè gǎndàole zāiqū, xiézhù jiùzāi gōngzuò.
examples.english: Shortly after this major earthquake occurred, soldiers immediately rushed to the disaster area to assist with disaster relief work.

examples.chinese: 這個教材比較難，老師怕學生不容易吸收，因此利用各種教學工具來幫助學生學習。
examples.pinyin: Zhège jiàocái bǐjiào nán, lǎoshī pà xuéshēng bù róngyì xīshōu, yīncǐ lìyòng gè zhǒng jiàoxué gōngjù lái bāngzhù xuéshēng xuéxí.
examples.english: This textbook is rather difficult; the teacher was afraid students wouldn't easily absorb it, therefore used various teaching tools to help students learn.

examples.chinese: 真正的朋友會幫助你、關心你，是絕對不會傷害你的。青少年常因為不了解而誤會父母的教育方式，或許等他們長大了，就能真正明白了。
examples.pinyin: Zhēnzhèng de péngyǒu huì bāngzhù nǐ, guānxīn nǐ, shì juéduì bù huì shānghài nǐ de. Qīngshàonián cháng yīnwèi bù liǎojiě ér wùhuì fùmǔ de jiàoyù fāngshì, huòxǔ děng tāmen zhǎngdà le, jiù néng zhēnzhèng míngbai le.
examples.english: True friends will help you and care about you; they will absolutely not hurt you. Teenagers often misunderstand their parents' way of education because they don't understand; perhaps when they grow up, they will truly understand.

examples.chinese: 九二一大地震時，臺灣人發揮了互相幫助的精神，讓人非常感動。
examples.pinyin: Jiǔ'èr yī dà dìzhèn shí, Táiwān rén fāhuī le hùxiāng bāngzhù de jīngshén, ràng rén fēicháng gǎndòng.
examples.english: During the 921 earthquake, Taiwanese people brought out the spirit of helping one another, which was very moving.

examples.chinese: 只有集合大家的力量，有錢出錢、有力出力，才能幫助災民早一點恢復正常生活。
examples.pinyin: Zhǐyǒu jíhé dàjiā de lìliàng, yǒu qián chū qián, yǒu lì chū lì, cái néng bāngzhù zāimín zǎo yìdiǎn huīfù zhèngcháng shēnghuó.
examples.english: Only by gathering everyone's strength—those with money contributing money, those with strength contributing strength—can we help the disaster victims return to normal life sooner.

examples.chinese: 因為有人喝酒後開車，造成了嚴重的交通意外，警察和救護車都趕來了。不管出國工作或留學，一定得買個平安保險，萬一發生什麼意外才能得到幫助。
examples.pinyin: Yīnwèi yǒu rén hējiǔ hòu kāichē, zàochéng le yánzhòng de jiāotōng yìwài, jǐngchá hé jiùhùchē dōu gǎnlái le. Bùguǎn chūguó gōngzuò huò liúxué, yīdìng děi mǎi gè píng'ān bǎoxiǎn, wànyī fāshēng shénme yìwài cái néng dédào bāngzhù.
examples.english: Because someone drove after drinking, it caused a serious traffic accident; both the police and ambulance rushed over. Whether going abroad to work or study, you must buy safety insurance so that in case any accident happens, you can get help.

examples.chinese: 小黃要去便利商店領錢， 我請他幫我買杯咖啡。老闆去歐洲旅遊回來，買了荷蘭傳統的點心送給大家，叫我們去助理那裡領。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Huáng yào qù biànlì shāngdiàn lǐng qián, wǒ qǐng tā bāng wǒ mǎi bēi kāfēi. Lǎobǎn qù Ōuzhōu lǚyóu huílái, mǎile Hélán chuántǒng de diǎnxin sòng gěi dàjiā, jiào wǒmen qù zhùlǐ nàlǐ lǐng.
examples.english: Xiao Huang is going to the convenience store to withdraw money; I asked him to buy me a cup of coffee. The boss came back from a trip to Europe and bought traditional Dutch snacks to give to everyone, and told us to pick them up from the assistant.

examples.chinese: A:謝謝你的幫助。沒有你的話， 我一個人很難完成新產品的廣告設計。 B:別這麼說。我們是同事，互相幫助是應該的。
examples.pinyin: A: Xièxie nǐ de bāngzhù. Méiyǒu nǐ de huà, wǒ yīge rén hěn nán wánchéng xīn chǎnpǐn de guǎnggào shèjì. B: Bié zhème shuō. Wǒmen shì tóngshì, hùxiāng bāngzhù shì yīnggāi de.
examples.english: A: Thank you for your help. Without you, it would be very difficult for me to complete the advertising design for the new product alone. B: Don't say that. We are colleagues; helping each other is only right.

examples.chinese: 許多大學生參加愛心服務的社團，幫助老人打掃環境。
examples.pinyin: Xǔduō dàxuéshēng cānjiā àixīn fúwù de shètuán, bāngzhù lǎorén dǎsǎo huánjìng.
examples.english: Many university students join volunteer service clubs to help the elderly clean up the environment.

examples.chinese: 莫以凡寫了一張卡片，感謝台灣朋友對他的幫助。
examples.pinyin: Mò Yǐfán xiě le yì zhāng kǎpiàn, gǎnxiè Táiwān péngyǒu duì tā de bāngzhù.
examples.english: Mo Yifan wrote a card to thank his Taiwanese friends for their help.

examples.chinese: 我喜歡週末跟家人聚在一起吃飯、聊天。愛心服務社把社員的愛心聚在一起，到安養院去幫助老人。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuān zhōumò gēn jiārén jù zài yīqǐ chīfàn, liáotiān. Àixīn fúwùshè bǎ shèyuán de àixīn jù zài yīqǐ, dào ānyǎngyuàn qù bāngzhù lǎorén.
examples.english: I like to gather with my family on weekends to eat and chat. The Love Service Club gathers the members' love together and goes to the nursing home to help the elderly.

examples.chinese: 陳小姐的工作能力很強，難怪可以當老闆的助理。
examples.pinyin: Chén xiǎojiě de gōngzuò nénglì hěn qiáng, nánguài kěyǐ dāng lǎobǎn de zhùlǐ.
examples.english: Miss Chen's work ability is very strong; no wonder she can be the boss's assistant.

examples.chinese: 我是陳老闆的助理，每天得向他報告公司的情況。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ shì Chén lǎobǎn de zhùlǐ, měitiān děi xiàng tā bàogào gōngsī de qíngkuàng.
examples.english: I am Boss Chen's assistant; every day I have to report the company's situation to him.

examples.chinese: 利用週末到安養院幫助老人，是很有意義的活動。
examples.pinyin: Lìyòng zhōumò dào ānyǎngyuàn bāngzhù lǎorén, shì hěn yǒu yìyì de huódòng.
examples.english: Using the weekend to go to a nursing home to help the elderly is a very meaningful activity.

examples.chinese: 像慢跑、游泳那樣的運動，對健康極有幫助。
examples.pinyin: Xiàng mànpǎo, yóuyǒng nàyàng de yùndòng, duì jiànkāng jí yǒu bāngzhù.
examples.english: Sports like jogging and swimming are extremely helpful for health.

examples.chinese: 護理師的工作就是幫助醫生處理病人的問題。
examples.pinyin: Hùlǐshī de gōngzuò jiùshì bāngzhù yīshēng chǔlǐ bìngrén de wèntí.
examples.english: A nurse's job is to help doctors deal with patients' problems.

examples.chinese: 我們都是好同學，應該互相幫助、互相學習。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen dōu shì hǎo tóngxué, yīnggāi hùxiāng bāngzhù, hùxiāng xuéxí.
examples.english: We are all good classmates; we should help each other and learn from each other.

examples.chinese: 我剛去工作的時候，常常需要同事的幫助。幫助別人讓我覺得很快樂！
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gāng qù gōngzuò de shíhou, chángcháng xūyào tóngshì de bāngzhù. Bāngzhù biérén ràng wǒ juéde hěn kuàilè!
examples.english: When I first started working, I often needed my colleagues' help. Helping others makes me feel very happy!

examples.chinese: 看見有困難的人們，有能力的話就得想辦法幫助他們，不應該不理他們。
examples.pinyin: Kànjiàn yǒu kùnnán de rénmen, yǒu nénglì de huà jiù děi xiǎng bànfǎ bāngzhù tāmen, bù yīnggāi bù lǐ tāmen.
examples.english: When you see people in difficulty, if you are able, you should think of ways to help them; you shouldn't pay no attention to them.

examples.chinese: 總統到地震災區慰問災民，並保證會協助他們恢復正常的生活。
examples.pinyin: Zǒngtǒng dào dìzhèn zāiqū wèiwèn zāimín, bìng bǎozhèng huì xiézhù tāmen huīfù zhèngcháng de shēnghuó.
examples.english: The president went to the earthquake disaster area to express sympathy and solicitude for the victims, and promised to help them restore a normal life.

examples.chinese: 要是你擔心營養不夠的話，吃點兒維他命對身體健康會有幫助的。
examples.pinyin: Yàoshi nǐ dānxīn yíngyǎng bù gòu de huà, chī diǎnr wéitāmìng duì shēntǐ jiànkāng huì yǒu bāngzhù de.
examples.english: If you're worried about not getting enough nutrition, taking some vitamins will help your health.

examples.chinese: 今天王醫師門診，沒有護理師協助，什麼事都得自己動手。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān Wáng yīshī ménzhěn, méiyǒu hùlǐshī xiézhù, shénme shì dōu děi zìjǐ dòngshǒu.
examples.english: Dr. Wang is seeing patients today, and without a nurse assisting, he has to set about everything himself.

examples.chinese: 跑步比賽的起點跟終點之間都有人協助，避免參加比賽的人發生狀況。
examples.pinyin: Pǎobù bǐsài de qǐdiǎn gēn zhōngdiǎn zhījiān dōu yǒu rén xiézhù, bìmiǎn cānjiā bǐsài de rén fāshēng zhuàngkuàng.
examples.english: Between the starting point and the finishing line of the running race, there are people assisting to prevent situations from happening to the participants.

examples.chinese: 中國古代的人們相信，當好人碰到危險或困難時，會有神仙到人間來幫助他們。
examples.pinyin: Zhōngguó gǔdài de rénmen xiāngxìn, dāng hǎorén pèng dào wēixiǎn huò kùnnán shí, huì yǒu shénxiān dào rénjiān lái bāngzhù tāmen.
examples.english: People in ancient China believed that when good people encountered danger or difficulties, immortals would come to the human world to help them.

items.wordHook: A 且(qiě) shelf holds up a heavy load, lending its 力(strength) so the load won't fall → 助(help).

examples.chinese: 一個人不管多有錢、多有地位，過世之後什麼也帶不走。
examples.pinyin: Yī ge rén bùguǎn duō yǒu qián, duō yǒu dìwèi, guòshì zhīhòu shénme yě dài bù zǒu.
examples.english: No matter how rich or how high-status a person is, after passing away, they can't take anything with them.

examples.chinese: 這支手錶是我過世的爺爺留給我的，對我來說具有特別的意義。我的老闆具有獨特的領導魅力， 員工都願意跟著他努力工作。
examples.pinyin: 1. Zhè zhī shǒubiǎo shì wǒ guòshì de yéye liú gěi wǒ de, duì wǒ lái shuō jùyǒu tèbié de yìyì. 2. Wǒ de lǎobǎn jùyǒu dútè de lǐngdǎo mèilì, yuángōng dōu yuànyì gēnzhe tā nǔlì gōngzuò.
examples.english: 1. This watch was left to me by my late grandfather; to me, it has special significance. 2. My boss has a unique leadership charisma; the employees are all willing to work hard following him.

examples.chinese: 高雄是台灣南部最大的城市，舉辦過世界運動會。
examples.pinyin: Gāoxióng shì Táiwān nánbù zuì dà de chéngshì, jǔbànguò Shìjiè Yùndònghuì.
examples.english: Kaohsiung is the largest city in southern Taiwan and has held the World Games.

items.wordHook: a 亼(gather) of friends meets under one roof to plan today's trends → 今(modern).
Combining 傷(injure) and 害(cause): 傷害 means hurt.
Bunches of freshly plucked 䒑(grass top) herbs divided into 八(eight) bundles fill a wide shallow 皿(dish) as trading 益(profit).
Stirring sticky 米(rice) in the pot so 胡(recklessly) that it melts into a thick paste leaves thoughts all 糊(muddled).
a 日(sun) glares off a car roof in the lot → 車(automobile).
